description: This file defines the VacancySearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class and encapsulates filtering parameters for vacancy searches in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for various filter criteria such as job title ID, employee number, status, name, publication status, and vacancy IDs, along with corresponding getters and setters. It also specifies allowed sort fields for vacancy search results.

classes.name: VacancySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filters when querying vacancies in the recruitment module. It includes properties for filtering by job title, employee number, status, name, publication state, and vacancy IDs. It also defines allowed sorting fields.

methods.description: Sets the array of vacancy IDs filter.
